name: ANSI/IEEE Ultrasonic NO switching output form
summary: IEEE-library form of ultrasonic no switching output: this form identifies a normally-open switching output in the ultrasonic sensor family.
description: This reference locates ultrasonic no switching output in Autodesk's IEEE-oriented ultrasonic switches family. This form identifies a normally-open switching output in the ultrasonic sensor family. The public library uses HPX11U for its horizontal representation; this is a vendor block name, not an IEEE standards symbol number.
